title: Would, and a Letter About a Trip
label: ch:ru-would-and-a-letter-about-a-trip
canDo: I can say what I would like with я бы хотел, what would happen with если бы, and write six connected lines about a trip that end on a condition.

payoff.summary: Complete RU-W270-pismo: six lines to one reader about a trip, the scene in the imperfective, the events in order in the perfective, a feeling, and a last line with бы.
